steps: Root verifies current full terminal, complete physical closure and unchanged frozen runtime; no input read before that release.

Root reviews missing independent oracle/fixtures, comparator, wrapper, tool/import identities, OS wall/memory/process constraints and strict public projection. All must be implemented, sealed, reviewed and privately admitted before any native run.

Root privately selects one existing original PMX2.0 file. Bind exact canonical path, file identity, byte length and sourceSHA privately; refuse archives, devices, network/reparse paths, unselected directories and identity changes. No extraction, authoring or dependency loading.
Create a fresh fixed private output directory with a source-pinned ACL/output policy. Freeze exact private admission manifests before launch; never copy them to a public evidence packet.

Acquire read-only source handles denying concurrent writes/deletes, verify canonical handle identity/regular-file scope, bounded size, bytes read and SHA before/after. Keep a stable admitted byte snapshot; any identity/size/hash mutation refuses. Wrapper/source-handle code is currently missing.

Run the independently qualified oracle first, with no candidate output present or available. It must independently locate every prefix/table boundary and capture ordered exact native fields from the same admitted bytes. Seal private witness and source/tool identities before candidate processing.

Run unchanged sealed candidate reader on the exact admitted immutable bytes under separate bounded ownership. Preserve its output including all unqualified flags unchanged. No authoring/import/renderer or simulation call.

Run separately reviewed strict private comparator: exact original table order/indices/counts, all stored names/rawname bytes/encoding, signed references/rawwidth words, unsigned masks, all bone optional payloads and all raw physicsF32words/offsets/end boundaries must match the independent witness. No tolerance, normalization or None substitution. Missing/extra data or any mismatch refuses.

Root independently verifies receipts, source/handle stability, process reaping/job closure, output allowlist/bounds, no original/main/REVIEW changes and exact private evidence bindings. Keep failures and refused attempts in their original fresh paths.

Only root-approved scalar procedural projection may be published. Private source IDs, arrays, counts/names/offsets/values, raw logs and private artifact hashes remain private. Native-table witness qualification, if earned, is per exact private inputs/profile and separate from unchanged candidate flags. No general PMX, decoded-object join, portable format, HAS or solver support claim.
